walkthrough:
In the right-angled triangle $\triangle CAB$ ($AC = 7\text{ cm}, BC = 8\text{ cm}$), calculate angle $\angle CBA$:
$$\sin(\angle CBA) = \frac{7}{8} \implies \angle CBA = \sin^{-1}\left(\frac{7}{8}\right) \approx 1.06544\text{ radians}$$
$$\text{Total central angle } \angle CBD = 2\angle CBA \approx 2.13087\text{ radians}$$

Calculate the area of circular sector $BCYD$ (radius $8\text{ cm}$):
$$\text{Area}(\text{sector } BCYD) = \frac{1}{2}r^2\theta = \frac{1}{2}(8^2)(2.13087) = 32 \times 2.13087 \approx 68.1880\text{ cm}^2$$

Calculate the area of triangle $\triangle BCD$ (base $CD = 14\text{ cm}$, height $AB = \sqrt{8^2 - 7^2} = \sqrt{15}\text{ cm}$):
$$\text{Area}(\triangle BCD) = \frac{1}{2}(14)(\sqrt{15}) = 7\sqrt{15} \approx 27.1109\text{ cm}^2$$
$$\text{Area}(\text{segment } CYD) = \text{Area}(\text{sector } BCYD) - \text{Area}(\triangle BCD) = 68.1880 - 27.1109 = 41.0771\text{ cm}^2$$

Calculate the area of semicircle $CXD$ (radius $7\text{ cm}$) and sum the regions:
$$\text{Area}(\text{semicircle } CXD) = \frac{1}{2}\pi(7^2) = 24.5\pi \approx 76.9690\text{ cm}^2$$
$$\text{Total Enclosed Area} = 41.0771 + 76.9690 = 118.046 \approx 118\text{ cm}^2 \quad (\text{to 3 s.f.})$$
